Characterization of small molecule drug clearance mechanisms using in vitro and in vivo approaches in drug discovery and development. Drug clearance is a fundamental pharmacokinetic parameter that governs drug elimination and influences half-life, bioavailability, and dose selection. Clearance occurs through multiple pathways, including hepatic metabolism, renal elimination, and biliary excretion.
